kilkee-cliffs: A coastal walkway along cliffs with distinctive rock formations.
lahinch-beach: A sandy beach popular for surfing and sea swimming on Ireland's west coast.
loop-head: A peninsula with cliffs and a classic lighthouse at the mouth of the Shannon estuary.
doolin-cave: A cave with one of the largest free-hanging stalactites in the world.
aillwee-caves: A cave system in the Burren with stone formations and an underground waterfall.
bunratty-castle-folk-park: A restored 15th-century castle with a folk park recreating rural Irish life.
burren-national-park: A unique limestone karst landscape with rare flora and trails in County Clare.
cliffs-of-moher: Cliffs 214 metres above the Atlantic Ocean, one of Ireland's most famous natural attractions.
galway-atlantaquaria: Ireland's national aquarium, in Salthill, with local marine life and interactive tanks.
diamond-hill: A trail in Connemara with panoramic views of Ballynakill Bay and the Twelve Bens.
dun-aonghasa: A prehistoric stone fort on the edge of a 100 m cliff on the island of Inishmore.
aran-islands: Gaelic islands at the mouth of Galway Bay, famous for their stone forts and traditional culture.
sky-road: A scenic coastal route around the Kingstown peninsula, with views of Clifden and the bay.
salthill: Galway's seaside promenade, with a beach, a sea pool and views over the bay.
connemara-national-park: A national park of mountains, bogs and wild ponies, with trails up Diamond Hill.
kylemore-abbey: A 19th-century abbey and castle in a stunning lakeside setting in Connemara.
battle-of-the-boyne-visitor-centre: A visitor centre telling the story of the 1690 Battle of the Boyne, at Oldbridge House.
loughcrew: A cluster of Neolithic passage tombs in the Loughcrew hills, with rock art.
slane-castle: A historic castle on the banks of the River Boyne, known for its concerts and distillery.
trim-castle: Ireland's largest Anglo-Norman castle, famous as a filming location for "Braveheart".
hill-of-tara: The ancient seat of the High Kings of Ireland, with monuments and panoramic views.
knowth: A great Neolithic passage tomb with the largest collection of megalithic art in western Europe.
newgrange: A Neolithic passage tomb over 5,000 years old, older than Stonehenge and the pyramids.
avondale-forest-park: A forest park with trails, treetop walks and history linked to Charles Stewart Parnell.
sally-gap: A scenic mountain pass in the Wicklow Mountains, surrounded by bogs where the rivers Liffey and Dargle rise.
